Comment: ExyokiOffice-owned overlay on the imported part metadata under data/parts.
A part descriptor there carries one folder for every parent it can be attached to, which cannot
describe the parts Office keeps in one fixed place per document family. 'theme' resolves against
the parent, so a slide master in /ppt/slideMasters would put its theme in /ppt/slideMasters/theme
instead of /ppt/theme; '../media' resolves to /media for the Word main document, which sits in
/word itself, instead of /word/media. The paths below are absolute and therefore independent of
the parent part. Keys are part names from data/parts; unknown names fail the build.
